about: What generated surfaces may use, on top of what the HUD accepts. The catalog says what the renderer can draw; this says what a model is trusted to draw on its own. Every number carries why it is this number, in docs/GENUI.md under Limits. `row_actions` is empty on purpose: a row button needs a handler for `e action <name> row=<id>`, and the surfaces daemon registers its names here when it has one.

excluded_components.File: an editable File writes to disk on save, and a generated path is a path nobody chose
excluded_components.Screen: the root Screen is s and is written by kyber-genui; a second Screen is never right
excluded_components.Rail: the launcher owns its own lane and is drawn by bin/kyber-surfaces, one per screen
excluded_components.Segmented: a press goes up as e action select, and nothing handles that for a generated surface yet
excluded_components.Avatar: its name is a person's name the model would have to write, and image is a path nobody chose

actions.genui-refresh: re-run the queries behind this surface and update its data in place
